t_advice_summary_textbox.text: When choosing the gnomes, go through all the colour options to work out which ones give the most mushrooms. This may change throughout the game.

vb_textbox.text: Try to choose all the colours in turn and try to remember which positions give the best points. It may be difficult to remember but if you forget, just keep choosing until you get a better idea. Remember to be quick and there is usually points to be had, whichever colour you choose.
